title: Investigate the shared Krea2 ID-Edit character-dataset workflow as an App candidate
description:
MERGED INTO MPI-348 on 2026-08-01 - closed as rejected: not built, folded into the host card, kept here as the record. Original text follows.

Read and evaluate a community Krea2 identity-edit workflow that builds a tagged character dataset from one reference image, and decide whether it is worth wiring as an App. Investigation only — no implementation on this card.
acceptance: Workflow JSON obtained and its node graph read end to end (source needs the VPN on)
Verdict on whether it actually does the job: identity held across the set, pose/expression/angle spread real, output usable as LoRA training data
Every custom node + weight it needs classified: already shipped / installable / blocked (licence, size, node lock)
Tagger decision made: keep its tagger, or swap to our own image_descriptor / Describe-Image harness, or a different LLM
The RTX 50xx attention patch assessed against our Pod image and local engine — needed, no-op, or harmful
Written recommendation: build as App, cannibalise the good parts into an in-house workflow, or drop — with the App shape sketched if it is a go
Findings land in docs/models/krea2/ (or a new docs page) and this card moves accordingly
